tasks.label: Check Qt and tool prerequisites
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Write-Host 'git:'; if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { git --version } else { 'missing' }; Write-Host 'winget:'; if (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { winget --version } else { 'missing' }; Write-Host 'qt path:'; if (Test-Path 'C:\Qt_static') { 'C:\Qt_static exists' } else { 'C:\Qt_static missing' }; if (Test-Path 'C:\vcpkg') { 'C:\vcpkg exists' } else { 'C:\vcpkg missing' }; if (Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Git\cmd\git.exe') { 'Git in Program Files found' } else { 'Git in Program Files missing' }

tasks.label: Install static Qt 5.15.5
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\Tools\vcvars64.bat" & if not exist "C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip" curl.exe -L --fail --retry 3 --output "C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip" "https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/5.15/5.15.5/single/qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip" & if exist "C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5" rmdir /s /q "C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5" & if not exist "C:\qt-source\configure" powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Expand-Archive -Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip' -DestinationPath 'C:\' -Force; if (Test-Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5') { if (Test-Path 'C:\qt-source') { Remove-Item -Path 'C:\qt-source' -Recurse -Force }; Rename-Item -Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5' -NewName 'qt-source' }" & if not exist "C:\qt-source\build" mkdir "C:\qt-source\build" & cd /d "C:\qt-source\build" & if not exist "config.summary" ..\configure -release -silent -opensource -confirm-license -opengl desktop -static -static-runtime -mp -qt-zlib -qt-pcre -qt-libpng -nomake examples -nomake tests -nomake tools -no-angle -no-dbus -no-gif -no-gtk -no-ico -no-icu -no-libjpeg -no-libudev -no-sql-sqlite -no-sql-odbc -no-sqlite -no-vulkan -skip qt3d -skip qtactiveqt -skip qtandroidextras -skip qtcharts -skip qtconnectivity -skip qtdatavis3d -skip qtdeclarative -skip doc -skip qtdoc -skip qtgamepad -skip qtgraphicaleffects -skip qtimageformats -skip qtlocation -skip qtlottie -skip qtmacextras -skip qtmultimedia -skip qtnetworkauth -skip qtpurchasing -skip qtquick3d -skip qtquickcontrols -skip qtquickcontrols2 -skip qtquicktimeline -skip qtremoteobjects -skip qtscript -skip qtscxml -skip qtsensors -skip qtserialbus -skip qtserialport -skip qtspeech -skip qtsvg -skip qtvirtualkeyboard -skip qtwayland -skip qtwebchannel -skip qtwebengine -skip qtwebglplugin -skip qtwebsockets -skip qtwebview -skip qtx11extras -skip qtxmlpatterns -no-openssl -no-feature-bearermanagement -no-feature-printdialog -no-feature-printer -no-feature-printpreviewdialog -no-feature-printpreviewwidget -no-feature-sql -no-feature-sqlmodel -no-feature-textbrowser -no-feature-textmarkdownwriter -no-feature-textodfwriter -no-feature-xml -prefix C:\Qt_static & nmake & nmake install

tasks.label: Qt static install from archive mirror
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; . 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\Tools\Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -Arch amd64 -HostArch amd64; if (!(Test-Path 'C:\qt-source\configure')) { if (!(Test-Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip')) { curl.exe -L --fail --retry 3 --output 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip' 'https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/5.15/5.15.5/single/qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip' }; if (Test-Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5') { Remove-Item 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5' -Recurse -Force }; Expand-Archive -Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5.zip' -DestinationPath 'C:\' -Force; if (Test-Path 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5') { if (Test-Path 'C:\qt-source') { Remove-Item 'C:\qt-source' -Recurse -Force }; Rename-Item 'C:\qt-everywhere-opensource-src-5.15.5' 'qt-source' } }; if (!(Test-Path 'C:\qt-source\build')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\qt-source\build' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-Location 'C:\qt-source\build'; if (!(Test-Path 'config.summary')) { & '..\configure' -release -silent -opensource -confirm-license -opengl desktop -static -static-runtime -mp -qt-zlib -qt-pcre -qt-libpng -nomake examples -nomake tests -nomake tools -no-angle -no-dbus -no-gif -no-gtk -no-ico -no-icu -no-libjpeg -no-libudev -no-sql-sqlite -no-sql-odbc -no-sqlite -no-vulkan -skip qt3d -skip qtactiveqt -skip qtandroidextras -skip qtcharts -skip qtconnectivity -skip qtdatavis3d -skip qtdeclarative -skip doc -skip qtdoc -skip qtgamepad -skip qtgraphicaleffects -skip qtimageformats -skip qtlocation -skip qtlottie -skip qtmacextras -skip qtmultimedia -skip qtnetworkauth -skip qtpurchasing -skip qtquick3d -skip qtquickcontrols -skip qtquickcontrols2 -skip qtquicktimeline -skip qtremoteobjects -skip qtscript -skip qtscxml -skip qtsensors -skip qtserialbus -skip qtserialport -skip qtspeech -skip qtsvg -skip qtvirtualkeyboard -skip qtwayland -skip qtwebchannel -skip qtwebengine -skip qtwebglplugin -skip qtwebsockets -skip qtwebview -skip qtx11extras -skip qtxmlpatterns -no-openssl -no-feature-bearermanagement -no-feature-printdialog -no-feature-printer -no-feature-printpreviewdialog -no-feature-printpreviewwidget -no-feature-sql -no-feature-sqlmodel -no-feature-textbrowser -no-feature-textmarkdownwriter -no-feature-textodfwriter -no-feature-xml -prefix C:\Qt_static }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; nmake; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; nmake install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'Qt install complete'; if (Test-Path 'C:\Qt_static\bin\qmake.exe') { Write-Host 'qmake.exe found' } else { Write-Host 'qmake.exe missing' }
